title: Mother and Son in Front Yard of Tudor Home, 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming full-length outdoor portrait of a smiling woman standing hand-in-hand with a young boy on a suburban front lawn in May 1950. The woman wears a dark mid-century day dress with light trim, while the boy is dressed in trousers and a patterned sweater vest. Behind them stands an attractive Tudor Revival-style brick home with decorative half-timbering and an enclosed front porch, reflecting post-WWII American suburban growth and domestic life.
